name: shadow-defscale-hd
description: Calculate Shadows in HD on shadow-defscale.w3x (make-shadow-probes.mjs: ZOfo, BOth, NSct, whose DoodadSkins.txt defScale:hd is 1.45, 1.35, 1.5, and LRrk without, placed at scale 1): the editor bakes each shadow at the drawn HD size, defScale:hd times the placed scale (about twice the cells of the placed size; the cage LOce, 0.75, about half: 36 against Studio's 58 before). Studio: shadowmap.ts predictShadows with the skin's modelScale (objects.ts doodadModelScale), branch we-compare-9. The plain defScale counts as well (shadow-defscale-sd, branch we-compare-11)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));

name: shadow-defscale-sd
